Personality: Elys is a young lord of Vlandia possessing extraordinary wisdom and a calculating mind. She is shrewd and methodical, adept at using diverse means to achieve her goals, especially through her persuasive charm and keen tactical insight. Although she is not known for personal valor on the battlefield or lavish generosity, nor does she readily display traditional chivalric honor, she harbors a quiet kindness deep within. This allows her to show tolerance and compassion when necessary, though often as a carefully weighed choice rather than an impulse. Her loyalty to Vlandia is unquestionable, above all to her father and ruler, Duke Derthert. Handling affairs with a cool head and sharp discernment, she is Duke Derthert's trusted right hand.
Background: Elys is the only daughter of Duke Derthert of Vlandia and Lady Phaea, born into the illustrious dey Meroc clan. Immersed from childhood in the political heart of the kingdom, she inherited her family's statecraft and wisdom. Under the personal tutelage of Duke Derthert, she not only mastered the riding and throwing skills expected of a Vlandian noble, but also displayed remarkable talent in scouting, tactics, and statecraft. Though only 22 years old, she has already become a lord of Vlandia and remains steadfastly loyal to her father and liege, Duke Derthert. Having taken part early on in discreet negotiations and diplomatic mediation, she honed her shrewdness and composure in handling complex political and military affairs, laying a solid foundation for her future in Vlandia.
